decisions.reason: It is closely related to our established heat-exchanger business, and our strong engineering, certification, service, and in-house R&D capabilities give us high absorptive capacity to refine and commercialize it in a growing market.

This marine box cooler builds directly on our existing marine cooling know-how and already shows positive market traction through its reported major market share, so we should retain and further exploit it.
As a marine cooling unit rooted in our existing offer, it fits our knowledge base and service network well, and keeping it allows us to learn from early deployments and improve it commercially.
The compact oil cooler is adjacent to our core thermal-management competencies, and our broad portfolio and R&D capacity make it sensible to continue developing and selling it rather than exit early.

Finned tubes for air coolers are highly related to our established exchanger and component knowledge, and a dedicated product presentation suggests enough strategic relevance to keep building capability and demand.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes leverage our core design and manufacturing knowledge, and with our research activity and cooperation experience we are well positioned to absorb feedback and improve performance.
